description: Defines the ScheduleItem class representing a scheduled session with properties, serialization, validation, and copy methods.

classes.name: ScheduleItem
classes.description: Represents a scheduled lesson/session between users with properties like start/end times, status, optional links and notes, and utility methods.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the ScheduleItem with selectively overridden properties.

methods.name: isChronologicallyValid
methods.description: Returns true if endTime is after startTime.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the ScheduleItem to a JSON-compatible map.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a ScheduleItem from a JSON map.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Serializes the ScheduleItem to a JSON string.

methods.name: fromJsonString
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a ScheduleItem from a JSON string.
